FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the documentary-style cold open — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off on a 14mm ultra-wide, framing with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
